details.question: How long do refunds take for prepaid orders?
details.answer: Refunds are issued after the returned item passes the quality check at our warehouse. Prepaid orders are refunded to the original payment method within 5-7 working days. Cash on Delivery orders are refunded by bank transfer (NEFT) within 7 working days after you share your bank details. [1]

details.question: I paid cash on delivery. How will I get my refund?

details.question: Can I return socks?
details.answer: Innerwear, socks, opened personal-care items, books with writing or damage caused after delivery, and products marked "Non-returnable" on the product page cannot be returned. Gift cards cannot be returned or exchanged. [1]

details.question: What is the return window for electronics?
details.answer: Most products can be returned within 10 days of delivery. Electronics have a 7-day replacement-only window: a defective or damaged electronic item is replaced with the same model, not refunded, unless the replacement is out of stock. [1]

details.question: Is shipping free?
details.answer: Shipping is free on orders of ₹999 or more. Orders below ₹999 have a flat delivery charge of ₹79. Express delivery (next working day, metro cities only) costs ₹149 and must be selected before payment. [1]

details.question: How much does express delivery cost?

details.question: How long does delivery take to Bengaluru?
details.answer: Orders placed before 2 PM on a working day are dispatched the same day. Metro cities (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune) usually receive orders in 2-4 working days. Other locations take 4-7 working days. [1]

details.question: What happens if the courier can't deliver my package?
details.answer: The courier makes up to three delivery attempts. If all three fail, the package is returned to our warehouse and the full amount is refunded within 7 working days of the package reaching us, minus any shipping charge. [1]

details.question: Is cash on delivery available for a ₹15,000 order?
details.answer: Cash on Delivery (COD) is available for orders up to ₹10,000 at serviceable PIN codes. A COD handling fee of ₹40 applies. Please keep exact change; couriers may also accept UPI at the door. [1]

details.question: Is there a fee for COD?

details.question: Money was debited but my order failed. What now?
details.answer: If money is debited but the order is not confirmed, the amount is automatically reversed to your account within 5-7 working days. You do not need to contact support for this. [1]

details.question: Can I add my GSTIN after placing the order?
details.answer: A GST invoice is emailed when your order ships and is also available on the order page. To add a GSTIN for business purchases, enter it at checkout before placing the order; it cannot be added afterwards. [1]

details.question: How do I claim warranty on my headphones?
details.answer: Electronics and appliances carry the manufacturer's warranty stated on the product page, usually 1 year from the date of delivery. Keep your ShopFlow invoice: it is required for any warranty claim. [1]

details.question: Does warranty cover water damage?
details.answer: Physical damage, liquid damage, damage from using third-party chargers, normal wear and tear, and products repaired by unauthorised technicians are not covered. [1]

details.question: How can I contact customer support?
details.answer: Email support@shopflow.example or call 1800-000-0000 (toll free), 9 AM to 9 PM IST, Monday to Saturday. Please include your order number for faster help. [1]

details.question: Can I cancel an order after it has shipped?
details.answer: A pending order can be cancelled from My Orders before it ships, and the full amount is refunded. Shipped orders cannot be cancelled; refuse the delivery or start a return after it arrives. [1]
